clips.title: The story
paras: Conservator Ilthalaine calls newly awakened night elves to tend Shadowglen’s wildlife. Young nightsabers and thistle boars have grown too numerous, and keeping Teldrassil’s natural harmony calls for stewardship and difficult choices.

In Shadowglen, beneath the Great Tree’s sprawling boughs, heavy spring rains have disrupted Teldrassil’s young, fragile forest cycle. Some wildlife populations have grown beyond what the land can sustain. They threaten to strip the glen of resources and bring famine to the ecosystem. Preserving the forest calls for active care.

Conservator Ilthalaine watches over Shadowglen’s woods, keeping any one part from overtaking the others. To prevent mass starvation among the animals, he sends young night elves into the grove to thin thistle boars and predatory nightsabers. The work is unglamorous, but vital: kaldorei stewardship means seeking harmony with nature through active balance and difficult decisions.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Greetings, friend. I am Conservator Ilthalaine. My purpose in Shadowglen is to ensure that the balance of nature is maintained.
The spring rains were particularly heavy this year, causing some of the forest's beasts to flourish while others suffered.

Unfortunately, the nightsaber and thistle boar populations grew too large. Shadowglen can only produce so much food for the beasts. Journey forth, young hunter, and thin the boar and saber populations so that nature's harmony will be preserved.

clips.title: Progress
paras: There is still work to be done, friend. Return to me once you have thinned the nightsaber and thistle boar populations.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You performed your duties well, friend.
